sentences.en: He went to art school to study painting and sculpture.
sentences.zh: 他去艺术学校学习绘画和雕塑。

sentences.en: This sculpture is more than two thousand years old.
sentences.zh: 这件雕塑已有两千多年的历史了。

sentences.en: The city holds an ice sculpture festival each year.
sentences.zh: 这座城市每年都会举办一次冰雕节。
